seo_title: KYC Management System — Overview | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.

blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of KYC Management System — Overview: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

KYC Management System is the orchestration layer for agentic operations: role definitions, task queues and bidding, durable execution with saga compensation, policy envelopes (solo/approval/forbidden), per-team budgets, kill switches, and a control tower for fleet health, throughput and cost per completed task.

blocks.title: KYC Management System — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: The decision layer is shared infrastructure: one contract per consumer, one ledger per decision, one owner per metric.

blocks.x: What holds KYC Management System — Overview together is discipline at the boundaries — typed contracts between stages, versioned releases, and a replay trail for every decision. The diagram above shows how the pieces compose; the gate reviews are what keep them honest.

Swarm treats agents as workforce, not scripts: onboarding with role specs, SLAs and budget; release management with shadow and canary cohorts; incident response with rollback. It runs our agentic process automation, digital workforce and workflow orchestration services under one accountable control plane.
